title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
statusText: 2026-09-13: bilingual website live and verified; standalone clone builds; old repository retired
summary: Canonical source is agent-orc/voice-lint. A fresh HTTPS clone of 68f224d passed npm ci, both libraries, Angular, .NET, the static website build and strict artifact validation. Its 141 content/asset files reproduce the release byte for byte; only build time differs in metadata. Devspace retirement commit 53188ed removes exactly 299 old Voice files and adds a pointer; unrelated tree entries and history remain intact, and the active dirty Devspace checkout is untouched. Public artifact a074139 contains 142 files and 48 EN/DE content routes with 18 fully translated German guides. Public verification checked every file hash and MIME type, redirects and private-route 404s, 96 browser views, 282 links/assets/fragments and 48 SEO routes with reciprocal language URLs and all internal anchors. The hub lists apps before libraries, names each library stack and links Voice through its project card; the separate header link, benchmark card and introductory work-model links are removed. Public English/German checks passed at 1440, 390 and 320px and without JavaScript. Source/translation hash checks and code/heading parity protect maintenance. Local Studio onboarding maps 45 original sources, including German guides. Product and guide text audits fixed unexplained evaluative modifiers, historical implementation prose and inconsistent German address; catalogue 0.2.2 has 33 passing tests. The updated VL-W1 record retains scope and dated evidence. Studio remains a supervised local preview. No model quality winner, AI authorship judgment, Google indexing/ranking or field Core Web Vitals result is claimed.
